passage: Generative AI is changing how we think about creativity. Instead of only humans writing stories or drawing pictures, AI can now help too. For example, a student might use a tool like DALL·E to make an illustration for a school report, or use ChatGPT to brainstorm ideas for a story. But even though AI can create amazing things, it’s not truly creative—it relies on patterns it has learned from large datasets.

subquestions.question: What is the main way Generative AI creates new content?

options.text: A. It copies other people's work directly
B. It uses patterns it has learned
C. It writes code from scratch

B.text: Yes—it uses patterns learned from data.

C.text: That's a use case, not the method.

D.text: AI predictions are based on learned data, not randomness.

subquestions.question: Which of the following is a real example from the passage?

options.text: A. AI painted the Mona Lisa
B. A student used ChatGPT to design a robot
C. A student used DALL·E to make an illustration
D. AI wrote a report about itself

C.text: Yes—DALL·E was used for an illustration.
